name: Specialist Agent Evaluation
description: Evaluates the specialist agent's ability to identify resource hubs and anchorages.

rubric_content.text_property: The agent identifies Nantucket Harbor as a major sailing hub.
The response is a valid JSON array of objects.
Every recommendation in the JSON response contains a valid 'url' and a non-empty 'reference_links' array.
The agent calls 'find_places_nearby' to locate anchorages or marinas.
